steps.title: Welcome to the QuEst Guide
steps.text:
This guided tour walks through tethered dye Brownian dynamics simulations using T4 Lysozyme (PDB: 148L) as the reference structure.

Click Next to explore the workspace.

steps.title: Structure Loading (148L PDB)
steps.text: The PDB file defines the macromolecular coordinates for dye attachment and collision calculations. In guide mode, 148l.pdb is automatically loaded as the target structure.

steps.title: Tethered Dye Physics & AV Parameters
steps.text: Configure the dye linker length (L), linker width (w), and attachment atom (e.g. Chain E, Residue 118, Atom CB). The accessible volume (AV) grid is calculated around this tether site.

steps.title: Photoinduced Electron Transfer (PET) Quenching
steps.text: Amino acids (Trp, Tyr, Met, His) quench fluorescence upon contact. The Quenching Chemistry table defines per-residue contact radii (Å), quenching rates (kQ), and diffusion slowing factors.

steps.title: 3D Molecular Structure (ChiMol)
steps.text: View the 3D macromolecular structure and dye attachment sites rendered interactively using the ChiMol OpenGL viewer.

steps.title: Run Brownian Dynamics Simulation
steps.text: Press Run Simulation (or press Ctrl+R) to compute dye diffusion trajectories, quenching events, FRET efficiency, and fluorescence decay histograms.

steps.title: Plots & Dynamics Diagnostics
steps.text: Inspect the calculated fluorescence decay, dye trajectory displacement |r − ⟨r⟩|, and position autocorrelation curves (ACF). Drag the splitter handles to resize plots as needed.
